claim_text: During The Patriots, Channel 14 aired an edited old Noa Rothman interview that made it appear she described Yasser Arafat as 'a charming person.'
notes: Narrow False verdict: contemporaneous ICE reporting preserves the exact broadcast capture and Magal's response acknowledging that material about Bill Clinton had been taken from the internet and pasted into the Arafat sequence. The 'charming person' description referred to Clinton, not Arafat. Magal said the main Patriots discussion concerned Rothman's phrase 'Uncle Yasser,' not the charming-person wording, and called Channel 14's use a mistake; no intent is inferred. Canonical Sheet was written first.
